note: Lemhi County has a development code with an Official Zoning Map adopted by reference, but no queryable ArcGIS REST or other zoning-district polygon service was found. The county parcel viewer (experience.arcgis.com f5d22beb...) shows parcels only. The IDWR, ISU, Idaho Tax Commission and ArcGIS Online searches found no Lemhi zoning layer. The City of Salmon zoning map (2021) is published only as a PDF, and the county site pages were not readable from here.
